name: xchain-contracts
description: XChain Platform contract template & pattern library: audited, copy-pasteable smart contracts plus a scaffold + lint CLI

engines.comment: Bounded to Node 22: the tests load xchain-vm, whose consensus runtime pins process.versions.modules to 127, so results taken on another Node ABI are not the fleet's. isolated-vm 6.2.0 ships prebuilt bindings for Node 22 (abi127) and Node 24 (abi137) alike, so the binding no longer sets the bound. See .nvmrc.

scripts.ci: node bin/ci-preflight.js && npm test && npm run lint
scripts.testComment: test/preflight.test.js runs FIRST and has no try/catch: without it a machine that cannot load isolated-vm reports 52 passing / 243 pending / exit 0 while 82% of the suite silently skips. test/gate-wiring.test.js locks that wiring in. See bin/ci-preflight.js for the same proof ahead of `npm run ci`.
